item.title: Taleco Gear Recalls Baby Jumpers, Baby Swings and 2-in-1 Baby Jumper & Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall and Strangulation Hazards
item.company: Online at Amazon.com, Walmart.com and TalecoGear.com from April 2021 through July 2026 for between $65 and $120.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com, Walmart.com and TalecoGear.com from April 2021 through July 2026 for between $65 and $120.
item.product: G Taleco Gear Baby Jumpers, Baby Swings and 2-in-1 Baby Jumper & Swings
item.summary: This recall involves G Taleco Gear Baby Jumpers, Baby Swings and Baby Jumper & Swings, sold in black, white, gray, pink, blue and green. The following model numbers are included in the recall: Product Name Model Number Baby Jumper jumper-01 Baby Swing swing-1 2-in-1 Jumper & Swing-A jumper-01 2-in-1 Jumper & Swing-B jumper-01 The model number can be found on the fabric wash and care label sewn into the fabric seat cover.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: G Taleco Gear Baby Jumpers, Baby Swings and 2-in-1 Baby Jumper & Swings.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled products immediately and contact Taleco Gear to receive a full refund. Consumers will be provided with instructions on how to destroy the recalled products and provide photos of the destroyed parts to obtain a full refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
